primitives.name: CLI Dispatch Relay
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Dispatch and poll `scripts/relay.mjs` wraps Claude Code's non-interactive `claude -p` mode, sends a brief on stdin, captures the structured stream, and writes `delegate-relay.result.v1`.
primitives.assumptions: Relay operates in isolated subprocess with controlled stdin and stdout.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs on malformed brief or unresponsive Claude process.

layer2.mapping: Relay mirrors Claude's non-interactive mode interface with explicit I/O control.
layer2.telemetry: Captured structured output stream and result file path.

primitives.name: Environment Isolation
primitives.verbatim_quote: When an orchestrator is itself Claude Code, the relay removes only inherited `CLAUDECODE` from the child environment so a separate CLI process can start.
primitives.assumptions: Child process requires clean environment to avoid conflicts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Inheritance of conflicting variables causes runtime errors.

layer2.mapping: Isolates CLAUDECODE variable while preserving credential integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Environment variable diff before and after relay invocation.

primitives.name: Git Fingerprinting
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | `--resume-last` | Resume the latest session for this cwd with Claude's `--continue`; send a delta brief.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'dirty_paths': 'list of filepaths', 'fingerprint': 'hash of file content', 'readOnlyViolation': 'boolean or null'}
primitives.assumptions: Git status provides deterministic path tracking for change detection.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unreadable or submodule paths cause incomplete fingerprinting.

layer2.mapping: Detects Git-visible changes via fingerprint comparison post-run.
layer2.telemetry: Change flags and fingerprint mismatches during artifact validation.

The failure modes include malformed briefs, unresponsive Claude, or inaccessible Git paths.
